docs.summary: YAML file format for EchoObject serialization. Zero external dependencies. Writes clean, human-readable YAML. Reads both Echo-produced and generic YAML. Supports mappings, sequences, scalars (strings, numbers, booleans, null), and !!binary. Note: Some type precision may be lost (e.g., byte/short → int, float → double). For exact type preservation, use EchoTextFormat or EchoBinaryFormat.
